timing: Retrospective rejection audit and prospective fit description. This contract was NOT recorded before the rejected v3 generation.

frame.physical_scale: One common world/pixel scale calibrated to the existing female SOUTH head width, including ears, at alpha>128. Authored family-scale choice, not a recovered native height.
frame.units: width and center_x are Qud cell-width units (2/3 world); height and center_z are world units. No per-facing rescale.

source_facts: Captured Horns575 is natural equipment on Head288, laterality0; description specifies a paired grooved bone extrusion.
authored_estimates: Ram-like curl, broad upper anterolateral roots, curl orientation and hidden-root geometry are authored interpretation, not recovered native joint coordinates. Final root extents remain to be constructed and reviewed.
item_geometry: Rejected v3 geometry is preserved in attachment-controls.json; no corrected item geometry or root coordinates are claimed here.

views.intended_fit: A paired horn item emerges continuously from broad upper anterolateral skull surfaces above the ears. Roots belong to the skull surface; horns grow outward/upward and curl backward. Show the near root transitions and distinct tapering bone tips; preserve the original ears below them.
views.manual_observation: Broad flat-ended horn bases sit beside the upper head without a convincing continuous skull transition. Mathematical root containment did not establish a visible attachment.
views.refined_observation: The same external, flat-ended bases remain. Improved ribbing/shading does not repair attachment.
views.correction: Rebuild the root transition into the upper crown surface before drawing the return curl; inspect continuous attachment on the unchanged head.

views.intended_fit: Show the same upper anterolateral root above and forward of the ear, with bone leaving the skull outward/upward before curling backward. Near horn may hide the far horn in exact profile. Preserve a separate flesh ear and the same anatomical origin as front.
views.manual_observation: The large curl occupies the posterior side of the head and reads as originating near the rear; the open flat cap does not establish the intended crown origin.
views.refined_observation: Posterior-origin reading persists, and the inner curl competes with the ear contour.
views.correction: Reproject the corrected shared crown attachment; retain a distinct ear and separate bone volume instead of moving a plausible-looking coil independently.

views.intended_fit: Show the rear surfaces of the same paired curls. The original skull occludes anterior roots where appropriate; exposed root transitions must still join the skull. Both original ears remain flesh below the roots, separate from bone.
views.manual_observation: Inner curls wrap around the ear silhouettes and read as bone extensions of the ears; root continuity is obscured rather than explained.
views.refined_observation: The ear/bone ambiguity remains, producing the boned-ear appearance identified by the user.
views.correction: Separate the horn volume and ear contour, with explicit skull occlusion; do not use the ear silhouette as a horn segment.

views.intended_fit: Mirror the corrected east anatomy for this symmetric paired natural Head item. Preserve the same root, curl direction relative to the skull, ear separation and near/far visibility.
views.manual_observation: No independently authored west view in this attempt; it would inherit the rejected east geometry.
views.refined_observation: Not generated separately; east failure prevents west acceptance.
views.correction: Derive west only after corrected east attachment and the symmetric-pair interpretation are visually reviewed.

advancement: Construction and refinement both fail. No extraction, fitted registration or generation-ready credit until geometry is corrected and compared with each facing description. Native validation remains deferred until the full generation set.
